name: Upload File
description: Upload a file to Google Drive. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/manage-uploads) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: parentId
configurable_props.label: Folder
configurable_props.description: The folder you want to upload the file to. If not specified, the file will be placed directly in the drive's top-level folder.

configurable_props.name: filePath
configurable_props.label: File Path or URL
configurable_props.description: Provide either a file URL or a path to a file in the /tmp directory (for example, /tmp/myFile.pdf).

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the new file (e.g. `/myFile.csv`). By default, the name is the same as the source file's.

configurable_props.name: mimeType
configurable_props.label: Mime Type
configurable_props.description: The file's MIME type (e.g., `image/jpeg`). Google Drive will attempt to automatically detect an appropriate value from uploaded content if no value is provided.

configurable_props.name: uploadType
configurable_props.label: Upload Type
configurable_props.description: The type of upload request to the /upload URI. Required if you are uploading data, but not if are creating a metadata-only file. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/reference/rest/v2/files/update#path-parameters) for more information.

options.label: Simple upload. Upload the media only, without any metadata.
Resumable upload. Upload the file in a resumable fashion, using a series of at least two requests where the first request includes the metadata.
Multipart upload. Upload both the media and its metadata, in a single request.

configurable_props.name: fileId
configurable_props.label: File to replace
configurable_props.description: ID of the file to replace. Leave it empty to upload a new file.

configurable_props.name: metadata
configurable_props.label: Metadata
configurable_props.description: Additional metadata to supply in the upload. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3/files) for information on available fields. Values will be parsed as JSON where applicable. Example: `{ "description": "my file description" }`
